title: Network Automation: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: A factory assembly line builds the same thing, perfectly, every time. Handcrafting is slow, and no two are alike. Automation puts the network on the assembly line.

scenes.heading: Assembly line vs handcrafting
scenes.narration: Automation brings a few clear benefits. It applies the same settings to every device. Idempotent means running it twice changes nothing new. Ansible is agentless, so nothing is installed on devices. It frees engineers for the work that matters.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. It helps engineers, not replaces them. Small networks benefit too. Ansible is agentless.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Automation means fewer mistakes and faster changes. Idempotent means safe to repeat. Ansible is agentless. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva automation lab.
